say:2:1611288002:1.source_cn: 伊芙看向你，你明白了她的意思，示意由她先询问。

say:2:1611288002:1.female: Evie gestures for you to let her speak first.

say:3:1611288003:1.text: Nothing to worry about. I'm just following up on the selection exam. You're responsible for storing and transporting the creatures used, yes?
say:3:1611288003:1.source_cn: 别紧张，我只是在做宫廷魔法师选拔赛一事的后续调查。你是...

say:4:1611288004:1.text: That's right. I handle storage, daily care, and logs. I always have accurate records. I've never broken regulations!
say:4:1611288004:1.source_cn: 呃，那些魔物啊……储存、日常管理和清点出库都是我负责的...

say:5:1611288005:1.text: As for transportation, I'm only responsible for transporting things from the warehouse to Solstice Hall. Anything beyond that is handled by senior staff authorized by Durella.
say:5:1611288005:1.source_cn: 至于运输，我只负责将魔物从库房运送到日时礼堂。由于选拔...

say:6:1611288006:1.text: Were you aware that a Hypofiend escaped during one of the trials?
say:6:1611288006:1.source_cn: 你知道有一个考场中的魔物逃逸了吗？

say:7:1611288007:1.text: Aware? She docked half my bonus over it! Said it happened on my watch!
say:7:1611288007:1.source_cn: 当然知道！就因为这件事，杜瑞拉女士扣了我半年的奖金！她...

say:8:1611288008:1.source_cn: 这根本……根本就是胡言乱语！

say:9:1611288009:1.text: I always keep full records. Nothing was mishandled!
say:9:1611288009:1.source_cn: 我明明做了记录，我负责的部分全程都没有任何问题！

say:10:1611288010:1.text: Why not appeal to the school?

say:11:1611288011:1.text: I did, but it didn't matter. Durella still shoved all the blame onto me...
say:11:1611288011:1.source_cn: 我申诉了，可是没有用，杜瑞拉还是坚持把责任归咎到我头上……

say:12:1611288012:1.text: I've been working here for sixteen years. I never missed a shift, and the warehouse I'm in charge of has never had a single problem.
say:12:1611288012:1.source_cn: 我已经在莱希拉姆工作了16年了。这么多年来，我从没有过...

say:13:1611288013:1.text: Durella's actions are a total slap in the face for my dedication. But what can I do? She's the acting headmistress, and I'm just a lowly staff member...
say:13:1611288013:1.source_cn: 杜瑞拉的行为根本就是对我责任心的践踏！可我又有什么办法...

say:14:1611288014:1.text: I see... Magister Merlin, did you need something from Liam as well?
say:14:1611288014:1.source_cn: 我明白了……梅林大人，你找莱姆有什么事情吗？
say:14:1611288014:1.male: I see... Magister Merlin, did you need something from Liam as well?

say:19:1611288019:1.text: Impossible! The warehouse has strict rules. Every time it's opened, the requester and I must both be present, and the proper magical authorization is required.
say:19:1611288019:1.source_cn: 这绝不可能！莱希拉姆的仓库有严格的开启要求，每次开启时...

say:20:1611288020:1.text: If these rules aren't followed, a major alarm is triggered. Even the late headmaster couldn't open it alone—there's no way the acting headmistress could.
say:20:1611288020:1.source_cn: 如果不遵守以上规则，就会触发大型警报。就算是正式校长也...

say:21:1611288021:1.text: Got it. Thanks for your cooperation.
say:21:1611288021:1.source_cn: 我明白了。谢谢你，感谢你的配合。
